coefficient_extraction.equivalent_Vandermonde: If x^{(j)} = x(g_j·w) and theta^{(j)}=theta(g_j·w) are the eleven coset conjugates, then (beta_0,...,beta_10)^T = V^{-1} (x^{(j)})_j with V the Vandermonde matrix V_{j k}=(theta^{(j)})^k.
coefficient_extraction.secondary_expansion_of_beta: Each beta_k is a degree-0 G-invariant rational function, hence a 12-vector over P0 in the certified secondary basis ['1', 'f7', 'f9', 'f10', 'f12', 'f14', 'f7^2', 'f7*f9', 'f9^2', 'f9*f10', 'f7^3', 'f9^2*f10']. Explicit cancelled numerators/denominators require Reynolds projection of the dual-trace (or multipoint interpolation of the Vandermonde system) applied to the weight-0 rational map a_i = Mbar^{-1}(P_i/tau^{33}).

dual_basis.b_recurrence: b_10 = 1; b_j = theta * b_{j+1} + c_{j+1} for j=9..0 (Horner: mu(T)=(T-theta) sum b_j T^j)
dual_basis.name: omega_k

minimal_polynomial.construction: mu is the characteristic polynomial of multiplication-by-theta on the coset permutation module; equivalently the resolvent of a separating H_i-invariant. G4 coset action supplies the Gal(L/K) permutation of order-image 660 on the 11 roots.

exact_equivalent_note: The dual-trace presentation beta_k=Tr(a_r omega_k) is an exact equivalent of the power-basis expansion: omega_k and Tr are explicit once mu and theta are fixed, and beta_k is uniquely determined in K_proj. Fully cancelled secondary 12-vectors for each beta remain residual (degree-33 invariant reduction).
label: A5_class_2
open: det M(w) != 0 and P_i(w) != 0 and tau != 0

phi_zero.proof: On the frame open, M a_i is projectively equal to P_i (after tau-normalization of weights). Phase 3 gives F(P_i)=0. By definition Phi(a)=F(sum a_r frame_r / tau^{deg}), so Phi(a_i)=0 as an identity of L_i-valued functions on the open.
